entries.title: II Chronicles 29:3
segments: In entering on a new situation, it is of great importance to begin right; for the first actions may have a leading influence upon all which follow.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:5
segments:
Sanctify now yourselves; they sanctified themselves and the temple by performing the purifications and cleansings required by the law of Moses, all which represented that inward purity of heart without which no outward worship or service is acceptable to God. 
 
Ministers of religion must themselves be holy, to be instrumental of promoting holiness in others.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:6
segments: The habitation of the Lord; the temple, where the Lord manifested his presence.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:8
segments: All troubles are the consequences of sin, and should lead men to repentance and to newness of life.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:15
segments: In reformations, ministers of the gospel and civil rulers should take the lead, go before the people in every good work, and set examples which all may safely and usefully follow.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:16
segments: The brook Kidron; a deep valley on the east of Jerusalem, through which, as in the case of many other valleys of Palestine, water flows only in the rainy season.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:17
segments:
Began--to sanctify; they began apparently with the courts of the temple, and came to the temple proper on the eighth day, occupying eight days more in cleansing it. 
 
  The first month; Nisan, part of March and April.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:25
segments: Hearty turning unto the Lord is a souirce of gladness and joy; and as it comes from God, and is the fruit of his Spirit, it should be acknowledged with adoring gratitude and praise.
